standard_prerequisites: the equivalence relation on the sphere identifying points reachable by a rotation through an angle in the countable group
the choice-of-representatives set C with one element per equivalence class
rotations as functions on the sphere
core_obligations: Prove that the unit sphere equals the union over all group rotations of the image of the representative set C
proof_roadmap: For any point s of the sphere, its equivalence class has its chosen representative r in C
s is equivalent to r exactly when some group rotation maps r to s, so s lies in the image of C under that rotation; the reverse inclusion is immediate since rotations map the sphere to itself
difficulty_reason: A short unfolding of the equivalence relation and the definition of the representative set; the reverse inclusion is immediate from the setup.
